note: SHA-256 hashes of terms that must never appear in this PUBLIC repository (issue #64): the operator's username, personal domain labels, employer/client names, and machine/device names. Stored as hashes, NOT plaintext, so this guard file does not itself leak the values it defends against.
ifThisFiresOnAnInnocentWord: Rename the identifier/fixture rather than deleting the hash. Delete a hash only if the term is genuinely not personal.
